name: Engineer
description: Project-forward portfolio for engineering professionals — electrical, mechanical, civil, industrial, chemical, and petroleum engineers. Built around project showcases with image cards, technical skills, and credentials. Inspired by greglagana.com's minimal clean style.
designNotes: The Engineer template follows greglagana.com's minimal, project-forward philosophy. White background with Space Grotesk headings gives technical authority without corporate stuffiness. Projects are displayed as clickable IMAGE CARDS in a grid — not text lists — because engineering hiring managers want to see what you built. Each project can link to a full detail page with narrative blocks (images, specs tables, challenge/solution, standards). Deep Steel Blue (#1e3a5f) accent conveys trust. Safety Orange (#f97316) highlights project types. Experience uses a two-column date/content layout. Skills are grouped by category. Education shows GPA badges. All sections auto-hide when empty, so a student with one project and no experience gets a clean page, while a senior engineer with certifications and work history gets the full layout. Explicitly excludes software/computer engineers — those belong in the Developer template.
